purpose: Record release-level evidence for body architecture without promoting market labels, maker prefixes, or visual similarity directly into mechanical truth.

evidence_levels.I0_catalog_thumbnail: Morphology/release discovery only; no hidden joint or dimension claims.
evidence_levels.I1_multiview_catalog: May support component seams, visible joints and proportion estimates.
evidence_levels.I2_disassembly_closeup: May support component graph and connector-form hypotheses.
evidence_levels.I3_physical_sample: May support measured dimensions, force, actual interchangeability and wear observations.
evidence_levels.engineering_authority: Authoritative engineering/CAD/component evidence where provenance permits.

rules: Maker/product prefix is never sufficient for MATCH.
BigFig, midfig, muscle body, 7CM, giant and mega fig remain source labels unless joint/component evidence supports a canonical architecture.
Manufacturing-critical connectors require I3 physical evidence or authoritative engineering evidence.
Unknown releases remain unknown rather than being coerced into the nearest architecture.
